nodes.label: ML-KEM-1024 Module-Lattice Key Encapsulation Mechanism
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 203 Category 5 post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism parameter set delivering maximum quantum-resistant encryption strength equivalent to AES-256.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Multi-Head Device (MHD) Architecture
nodes.description: CXL hardware component specification allowing a single memory controller or memory expansion device to connect directly to multiple distinct host root complexes via dedicated physical ports.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Arabic Part-of-Speech (POS) Tagger Subsystem
nodes.description: Morphology-aware POS tagging module in CAMeL Tools assigning detailed morphosyntactic tags (CATiB, Buckwalter, and UD formats) to Modern Standard and Dialectal Arabic texts.

nodes.label: W3C Terse RDF Triple Language (Turtle) Standard Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a compact, human-readable textual syntax for serializing RDF graphs using prefix directives and abbreviated predicate-object lists.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Element-Wise Matrix Operations (GrB_eWiseAdd / GrB_eWiseMult)
nodes.description: Algebraic kernel family in GraphBLAS executing point-wise operations over sparse matrices using intersection (eWiseMult) or union (eWiseAdd) set semantics.
